xna-type.name: IAvatarAnimation
xna-type.summary: Provides methods and properties for animating an avatar using custom animations. Allows for easier integration between custom animations and built-in animations.
xna-type.remarks: For more information, see Rendering and Animating Avatars (Xbox 360) .

property.name: BoneTransforms
property.summary: Gets the current position of the bones at the time specified by CurrentPosition.

property.name: CurrentPosition
property.summary: Gets or sets the current time position in the animation.

property.name: Expression
property.summary: Gets the expression of the related animation at the current time position.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Gets the length of the current animation.

method.name: Update
method.summary: Updates the current time position of the avatar animation.

overload.summary: Updates the current time position of the avatar animation.

parameters.parameter: Elapsed time since the last animation frame. This value can be a positive or a negative time span. If the value is negative, animation playback is reversed.
true if animation playback is to be looped; otherwise, false .
